purpose: 确认 P7 筛出的工况相关正常性与源域阈值失配，并区分排序退化与阈值校准失配。

protocol.scaler: fit on source train-normal VIN only

excluded_model.DCdetector: P7 same-condition sensitivity is too low for a directional calibration claim; retain as supplementary diagnostic only.

primary_confirmation_rule: For at least two models and both chemistries, cross-condition target-normal P99 FPR must exceed its same-condition reference by >=0.10 in at least two of three model seeds. AUPRC must be reported separately to decide whether the issue is calibration-only or representation failure.
next_gate: Only after this confirmation may a condition-aware anomaly model be designed and compared with the frozen baselines.
